verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Paddle's merchant-of-record model where Paddle itself is the seller of record for a single business (subscriptions, checkout, dunning, tax compliance, payouts to the business owner) — there is no mention of onboarding multiple third-party sellers, splitting payments between parties, or paying out to distinct sellers on a marketplace. This is a fair question for a payments platform to be asked, but nothing in the pack shows Paddle supports multi-party marketplace payment splitting or seller onboarding flows analogous to Connect-style platforms.
